+# modelled after sys.version_info
+_VersionInfo = namedtuple('_VersionInfo',
+                          'major, minor, micro, releaselevel, serial')
+
+
+def _parse_to_version_info(version_str):
+    """
+    Parse a version string to a namedtuple analogous to sys.version_info.
+
+    See:
+    https://packaging.pypa.io/en/latest/version.html#packaging.version.parse
+    https://docs.python.org/3/library/sys.html#sys.version_info
+    """
+    try:
+        v = parse_version(version_str)
+        if v.pre is None and v.post is None and v.dev is None:
+            return _VersionInfo(v.major, v.minor, v.micro, 'final', 0)
+        elif v.dev is not None:
+            return _VersionInfo(v.major, v.minor, v.micro, 'alpha', v.dev)
+        elif v.pre is not None:
+            releaselevel = {
+                'a': 'alpha',
+                'b': 'beta',
+                'rc': 'candidate'}.get(v.pre[0], 'alpha')
+            return _VersionInfo(
+                v.major, v.minor, v.micro, releaselevel, v.pre[1])
+        else:
+            # fallback for v.post: guess-next-dev scheme from setuptools_scm
+            return _VersionInfo(v.major, v.minor, v.micro + 1, 'alpha',
+                                 v.post)
+    except (AttributeError, ValueError):
+        # Cannot infer major/minor/micro version for the version strings
+        # that do not conform to PEP440 that we want to support, e.g.
+        # 3.5.0rc1 (this is not a valid pep440 pre-release, as "rc1" is not
+        # preceded by a dash), so we fallback to parsing it ourselves in that
+        # case.
+        match = re.match(
+            r'^(?P<major>\d+)\.(?P<minor>\d+)\.(?P<micro>\d+)', version_str)
+        if not match:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f'"{version_str}" is not a valid version string') from None
+        return _VersionInfo(*(int(s) for s in match.groups()), 'alpha', 0)
+
